slices.title: Verification reaches the user (chip and enforce)
slices.summary: Carry the report on the attachment SSE event as an optional check key (no new event name) and show a generated-file chip (Kontrollert, Advarsler, Feil funnet, via i18n.tr) that never claims the file was verified in Office. In enforce mode a failed file is withheld once per turn per name so the model can repair it.

slices.title: Do browser open, observe and close on real grants
slices.summary: Adds a BrowserSession in execution-core that resolves policy, acquires a broker grant, starts a Quarry run and navigates, and offers server-bound browser.open, browser.observe and browser.close to the Do loop with no ids in model-visible text. It also releases grants at run end and on cancel, maps browser.open and browser.observe to cap.browser.observe (the legacy browser_agent stays on cap.browser.open), seeds cap.browser.observe (low) and cap.browser.act (medium, starts unavailable) through a new capability-core migration, and attests health only when the broker and Quarry are ready.
slices.flag: EXECUTION_DO_BROWSER_ENABLED together with BROWSER_BROKER_SITE_POLICY=enforce; browser.act is not offered in this slice
risk: cross-branch: the Quarry-side grant issuance endpoint and Quarry-to-broker identity are built on local branch quarryv2, not on model-plane; build against the contract with a stub and leave the live proof to the lead after quarryv2 merges

decisions_defaults.DEC-19: (d) layered: Control org-core is policy of record, broker enforces at mint from the verified principal, Quarry stays final enforcer. One grant per (run, level), fence = start host + at most 8 hosts; open web minus block list default; private/loopback never gra
decisions_defaults.DEC-20: Server-bound: model sees `browser.open{url}`, `.observe{}`, `.act{action}`, `.close{}`. New cause `browser_site_consent`. Grant minted under the user's delegated BrowserBroker bearer, never from request JSON. Grant store decided by QRY; WS21 works on in-memory
decisions_defaults.DEC-02: (b): every WS03 trigger has a user present, so no bearer is stored; scheduled lane carries service credentials only and is bounded by a 240 s wall clock; browser mints lazily and parks for a refresh click (`browser_credential_expired`). Reject (c). OD8 itself
